entities.summary: Tareg Hamedi (b. 1998-07-26, Jubail) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Jubail and Saudi Arabia. Known in the fields of saudi arabia, architects & designers, asia.
